testCases.title: Verify accessibility of the contact form
Ensure all required fields are displayed
steps: Inspect the contact form for required fields.
expectedResults: All required fields are displayed in the contact form.

testCases.title: Validate subject dropdown options
steps: Open the subject dropdown in the contact form.
expectedResults: The subject dropdown contains the specified options.

testCases.title: Check validation for message character count
steps: Enter a message with fewer than 50 characters.
expectedResults: A validation error is displayed for the message.

testCases.title: Verify confirmation message upon successful submission
steps: Fill in all required fields in the contact form.
